default.text: You're the shine my boy's afraid of. Hamm Harrow. This is my land. Walk slow on it and we'll have no quarrel.

options.text: Pip told me about the barn.

barn.text: Then you know why. The dog was called Biscuit. Pip was eleven when he got him. Don't run near the cows.

farm.text: Good soil, bad year. The Company lent me seed money at the thaw. I'll pay at harvest, if the harvest and the goblins both allow.

farm_kind.text: I don't ask your kind for things. ...But I heard you. That's more than the last one got.

farm_plain.text: Thirty crowns, and the interest. Holt writes the interest. I only sign.

farm_hard.text: And eat what, till harvest? Advice comes cheap from a man who can't starve.
